headline: Stage 2 (verify in data) fully closed: all four original calculation suspicions (C-1 through C-4) resolved, plus two more found and fixed along the way (C-5, C-7). Two of these (C-3+C-5, C-7) were live wrong numbers in production, not just theoretical - C-7 alone understated the dashboard's most prominent debt figure by ~18,441. Mobile edit form, backup tab, and sync indicator also reworked this round. Screens (stage 6) not yet designed.

verification.forecast_fix_c3_c5: Live scenario (opening 10000, past expense 4000, known future expense 6000, day 13/30): projected went from -13894.49 to -6048.34 (card) and the forecast chart's month-end point from +769 (sign-flipped vs the card) to -5230.77 (same sign). Reviewed by domain-risk-reviewer before implementation. Full numbers in CALC_LOGIC_MAP.md section 3.
verification.father_debt_dedup_c4: domain-risk-reviewer found the exact date+amount collision C-4 describes already live in the latest production backup (23/03/2026, 1000). Asked Raz directly whether it was one transfer or two - confirmed one, so the existing merge/total was already correct. Added a merge-transparency badge (getCombinedFatherRepayments now records mergedWith) with zero change to any total, so a future wrong merge is visible instead of silent.
verification.loan_interest_c2: LOAN_SCHEDULE has always carried total/interest/principal per installment (36 installments, June 2025-May 2028, 4206.43 total interest) but every consumer read .principal only. Fixed across all 7 read sites (closing balance, dashboard widgets, yearly table, debt modal, dashboard hero, direct display) - confirmed live: March 2026 test sheet's closing balance dropped by exactly 164.53 (that installment's interest) after the fix. Loan-payoff-progress figures (bankRemaining, loanPrincipalBase) confirmed unchanged, correctly still principal-only. One-time historical jump for every month back to June 2025 - real and correct, not a new bug.
verification.debt_remaining_chip_c7: getTotalDebtRemainingSummary()'s bankPaidPrincipal summed all 36 installments unconditionally (identical to getLoanPrincipalBase()), so bankRemaining was always exactly 0. Confirmed against the real backup: the dashboard's total-debt chip showed 16500 instead of the correct ~34941 (understating by ~18441). Fixed with the same date filter already correct in three sibling implementations; post-fix the dashboard chip and the debts tab agree (18441.50 both).
